name: handoff-guard
description: Model-aware handoffs, deterministic model recommendations, and execution preflight for coding agents.

interface.longDescription: Preserve settled implementation decisions, recommend the cheapest sufficient provider/model tier, and run a preflight before a receiving agent changes files. Handoff Guard is advisory when the host cannot expose current model metadata and never switches models or providers automatically.
defaultPrompt: Create a structured handoff for the next coding agent.
Recommend a model and run preflight before implementation.
Validate this handoff without changing the settled architecture.
